fuel_consumption.source_quote: Excluding the impact of fuel hedges, a hypothetical 10% increase in the full year December 31, 2008 cost per gallon of fuel, assuming projected 2009 mainline and regional aircraft fuel usage, would result in an increase to aircraft fuel expense of approximately $584 million in 2009.

instrument_type_details.notes: Combination of crude oil collars, three-way crude oil collars, three-way heating oil collars, crude oil swaps, and jet fuel swaps. After October 29, 2008 Delta merger closing, certain contracts were designated as cash flow hedges under SFAS No. 133. Prior to merger, all contracts were mark-to-market through P&L. NWA merged with Delta Air Lines on October 29, 2008; this is the final NWA standalone 10-K filing.

warnings: Northwest Airlines merged with Delta Air Lines on October 29, 2008. This is the final NWA standalone 10-K.
After Delta merger closing, certain fuel derivative contracts were designated as SFAS No. 133 cash flow hedges; OCI unrealized losses of $71M relate to post-merger designated period only.
Company paid $67.4M to enter offsetting contracts in December 2008 to effectively settle existing Q3-Q4 2009 three-way crude oil collar contracts covering ~3% of 2009 requirements.
